verdict.rationale: Highnote's issuing docs say it supports creating and managing customizable payment cards, explicitly including physical cards, through a platform built around its GraphQL API. Beyond that single mention, the evidence says nothing about how physical card fulfillment actually works. missing for 10: documented API for ordering physical cards, custom card art/personalization details, bulk ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, confirmation that Highnote manages the card manufacturer relationship, independent or hands-on corroboration.
